names.why: 'Cardio' covers running, cycling and rowing, but 13 of 33 videos are rock climbing, mountaineering, abseiling, pool diving, a pool float, high jump and beach volleyball; the group is defined as sport out in the open. (Same word is my second choice for 206 in old group 2, so only one of the two tiles should take it.)

notes: No moves. 882 (key word 'workout', a full routine in a gym) sits in Gym while the neighbouring tile is itself named 'Workout'; the clip is a gym clip so I leave it, but the name collision is visible. 5613 (boulder held on an outdoor court) is a feat of strength and fits Gym.
